chapter: Duke, Gensel and the later years
title: Newport house band and the 'Misty' singer
summary: The trio lasts until 1963-64; he recalls writing for a singer at Newport.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: The group with Phil Porter, how long did that last?
Well, we stayed together for about...oh, I guess from '61 up until about '63 or '64. Then we broke up shortly after that.
In '63, if I'm not mistaken (although I could have the

years wrong; we can check this), you did that tribute to Bird at Newport with Sonny Stitt... And you did other special... You did a lot of different special things at Newport. You were in the Newport house band...
Yeah, I was in the house band. I wrote some arrangements for a girl singer they had... I'm trying to... What are some colored singers you know?
I know a lot of them. But you're not talking about Sarah or Ella...
No, not here. Dinah was not... Not Dinah Washington. That's another thing I'm trying to...
I remember once you were in the house band with Hawk, Zoot, Clark Terry...
"Misty." The girl singer that did "Misty." Do you know who it is?
I remember Sarah Vaughn doing "Misty", but...
